messages.subject: 'discrete' time series x-axis label problem
parts:
Hi all,

I received great help in getting my time series underway, thanks to
this great group! But..., please,

1. I'm still at a loss to remove the years from the x axis label. The
data represent several years - I only to show months. The steps on
page 101 of the text are returning 'wrong sign error'.

2. I would like to trim off the 'Dec-03' and 'Jan-05' from the ends of
the scale.

I'm new to R and your help has been critical and greatly appreciated.
Thank you again, in advance! (The data set is in the file section -
lake.csv.)

library(ggplot2)
lake <- read.csv("lake.csv")
lakem <- melt(lake, id = "Month")
date <- paste("01-", lakem$Month, sep = "")
lakem$date <- as.POSIXct(strptime(date, "%d-%b-%y"))
aa <- ggplot(lakem, aes(date, value, colour = variable)) +
stat_summary(geom = "line", fun.y = "mean", size = 1) +
stat_summary(geom = "errorbar", fun.ymin = "min", fun.ymax = "max",
size = .7)
bb <- aa + opts(title = "Lake surface (1mbs), 15mbs, and below dam
") +
labs(y = "Water Temperature (ºC)
", x=NULL)
# removing successive non-data parts

bb <- bb + opts(panel.grid.minor = theme_blank()) + opts
(panel.grid.major = theme_blank()) +
opts(panel.background = theme_blank()) + opts(axis.title.x =
theme_blank()) +
opts(axis.line = theme_segment())
bb <- bb + opts(legend.position=c(0.27,0.67))
cc <- bb + opts(plot.title = theme_text(size = 11, face = "bold"))
cc

Anthony Jagger
